text:
Maya C: FYI new hire Thomas G's background check returned a name mismatch flag. HR says it's likely a maiden/married name issue. Thomas is starting Wed and needs building access + laptop.
Evan S: how urgent is the mismatch? can he still start remote? on-site?
People Ops (Pia): we can allow a contingent start. two rules: 1) I-9 must be completed (we accept e-I9 + remote verification within 3 business days), 2) contingent hires get a limited badge (floor-only) until BGC clears. need documented exception in the file.
Thomas G: hi all 1260a I'm available Wed. I have passport and a court name-change certificate scanned. background vendor flagged because SSN name != passport name on file. vendor requested secondary docs.
Maya C: thanks. please upload the certificate to the secure HR intake link. I'll attach the vendor note to the case.
IT Ops: for Wednesday: we can stage a MacBook at reception and create a temporary AD account with time-limited creds. confirm asset needed (13\" vs 14\") and we can image overnight.
Facilities: we can issue a temporary paper badge for the first 3 days; after final verification we'll swap for a permanent badge. badge pickup at 08:45.
security-bot: Automated note: contingent badge policy applied. Access scope: building lobby, 6th floor open desks. No access to secure lab or server room. Audit tag: SB-66-2401.
People Ops (Pia): action items: 1) Maya to open HR case & attach name-mismatch vendor note; 2) Thomas to upload name-change doc via secure link; 3) IT Ops to stage laptop LTP-3371; 4) Facilities to reserve temp badge; 5) Pia to log contingent start exception: HR-4520.
Maya C: created case HR-4520 and added vendor PDF. Thomas, DM me if you need the upload link resent.
Thomas G: uploaded certificate and the vendor message at 21:10 last night. thanks for fast turnaround.
Evan S: quick question about benefits enrollment 124dd will contingent hires be blocked from enrollment?
People Ops (Pia): no, benefits enrollment is available on Day 1 as long as signed offer and W-4 are complete. we'll run a benefits walkthrough at 10:15 during orientation. bring dependent SSNs if enrolling dependents.
IT Ops: laptop imaged as LTP-3371; label says "Thomas G - ONBOARD". temporary AD account created: thomas.g.temp (expires in 7 days). Please remind Thomas to enroll MFA in first login.
Facilities: badge ready. pickup instructions: desk A reception, ask for onboarding queue, present govt ID.
Maya C: small note on payroll docs: please double-check that the W-4 name matches payroll system. mismatches can delay first payroll.
People Ops (Pia): closing: contingent start ok with logged exception HR-4520, temp badge & laptop staged, Thomas to complete I-9 remote flow within 72 hours and upload final BGC docs. I'll follow-up with checklist email to Thomas + hiring manager.
Thomas G: appreciate the help. see you Wednesday morning, will bring ID and the printed certificate. :smile:
